answer: Verifiable delay as an identity tax. Each new identity must solve a sequential puzzle that cannot be parallelised, so ids arrive at a fixed rate. A pigment swarm hits the same jade wall as a single agent, and the zenith time cost makes bulk registration impractical. Layered on top: Graduated privilege by tenure. Concretely here (829957): jade admission binds each pigment to one zenith root, so a duplicate is priced, not merely detected.
